title: Stair Cutter
description: A simple Minecraft Mod that adds a tool to cut whole blocks into stairs, and rotate them.
body:
![The mod tool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6dde810a38e5eff61184c1164742edc3582f3212.gif) 
# Stair Cutter

This mods adds a simple tool that cuts whole blocks into their stairs forms and rotates already set stairs.
It also adds stonecutter recipes for logs and planks.

## Usage
![The Grinder crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaa37e9b024437302bb3eda3ed7e1f586c8c6c8d.png)

Right click a block with the Grinder to cut it into it's stairs form (if it exists!)

Right click a stairs block to rotate it clockwise. Sneak right-click to turn it upside-down.
